title: Gardiiɗo Jardiin oo
intro: E nder jarne ɓuuɓɗo, renndo waɗii hunnde mawnde. Kono pellital maɓɓe jarribaama nde yiɗde Alla naati, wayli ngalu maɓɓe e leydi ndi alaa ko woni e mum.
clues: En keɓii barke e gesa keewɗo, kono en ngonti mawnikinaare.
Min mbaɗii peeje ngam dañde ko min ndenndi e miskineeɓe.
Min njalti subaka law, min ngoongɗini peeje amen.
Kono nde min njottii, min tawi gesa amen oo ina yani e jamma gooto.
Min paami majjere amen, min puɗɗii aybinde koye amen.
En tuubniima haa laaɓi, kono janngo ngoo janngaama haa ɓooyi.

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Ɓe tuubi kono ɓe keɓii gesa maɓɓe
outcome.answer: Ɓe tuubi kono ɓe keɓii gesa maɓɓe

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
